integrity: The proof is analytical. Rational endpoint sign checks are included with exact standalone Python source; Monte Carlo is supplementary only. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The inverse fibers are proved to have at least three members, with no global upper bound on the number of members.
The distance is ambient Euclidean distance on unglued planar sectors, not intrinsic distance on quotient cones.
No claim on all distance moments, full distributions, or statistical stability.
title: Threefold ambiguity of two Euclidean distance moments for planar circular sectors
